title: Data-quality sensitivity: do COMPADRE QC failures change medicinal-species conclusions?
question: How many medicinal matrices fail QC (NA, survival>1, A!=U+F+C) and would including them shift species-level median lambda?
hypothesis: <10% fail QC; species-level median lambda shifts <0.01 when failing matrices are excluded.
finding: 15% of medicinal matrices fail at least one QC check (hypothesis <10% rejected). Median species-level lambda shift is 0.000, but 9 species shift >0.05 (survival>1 matrices can produce extreme lambda). Decision: QC-failing matrices are never used as Simulate presets.
